credits.title: Sisters
credits.overview: Two sisters bring their families together for a summer weekend near Madrid to celebrate milestones and the San Juan Festival. The celebration turns dark when a child makes a serious sexual abuse allegation.

credits.title: High River
credits.overview: Bilbao, 1983. Torrential rains cause the river to overflow, flooding the city and plunging it into chaos. Meanwhile, the gay club High remains open, operating intermittently through power cuts as some men continue to come, suspended in a limbo of desire. credits.overview: A masked man plunges into the shadows of a remote darkroom nightclub. Speakers throb as bodies collide to the pulse of industrial music. credits.title: Heavenly Bodies
credits.overview: After a night of self-destruction and chaos, Enzo records a suicide note as a cry for help. However, despite believing no one is listening, someone will remind him that he is not alone. Even if that someone is from some remote corner of the universe.

credits.title: El mal
credits.overview: “El mal is basically a suspense story, where the audience senses that something disturbing is going to happen, but doesn't know how or when. But it also aims to get the viewer to question their own certainties, their capacity to love and to accept their own dark side.”

credits.title: Muy difícil
credits.overview: Eloy, a 26-year-old man, remembers his first homosexual experiences in his hometown, entering a journey full of subjectivity and the anecdotes that have marked him.

credits.title: Picking You Up
credits.overview: Six in the morning of a Friday like any other in Madrid. As usual, Carlos (20) and Dani (22) have been out all night, at a club. As part of their particular party ritual on the weekends, they decide to go to a gay sauna to continue the party.
